body:
# Dye Blocks
Concrete is so last year. Quench your thirst for actually solid-colored blocks without compromising on the vanilla feel!

!["Dye Blocks" with a rainbow pattern in the background.](https://files.ducky.wiki/share/public_assets/mods/dyeblocks/Block_Banner_720h.png)

# Usage
- Craft the **Dye Template** item using **x9 White Dye**.

- ![Crafting recipe for the Dye Template](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0e96253bd2293c3539f3afb98601a0cdd0eb8a25.png)

*Dye Template crafting recipe*

- Right now, the Dye Template item is only used to craft the **Dye Template Block**
- Craft the **Dye Template Block** using **x9 Dye Template**

- ![Crafting recipe for the Dye Template Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4de466f2e803548d065415f023e79a604b95f92b.png)

*Dye Template Block crafting recipe*
  
![Dye Template Blocks arranged in two smiley faces](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cff8d3be6314fc0550a5f86a078380e6ab45d1d8.png)
*Dye Template Blocks*

- Place & Right-click on a **Dye Template Block** with any **dye** to create a dye block.

![A GIF showcasing placing a purple dye onto a Dye Template Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a286c8f14c7300962ad181e8459e0d75debd0b53.gif)

- The **Super Dye Block** is crafted shapelessly using **x8 Dye Blocks** and a **Dye Template Block**.

- ![Super Dye Block crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8247ae407f490cbe4ed3892f590133aa2e508876.png)

*Super Dye Block crafting recipe*

- The Super Dye Block cycles its texture between all 16 colored Dye Blocks.
![The Super Dye Block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9415ab004f9290c7045213bd3d953898125374c7.gif)

### Supported Versions
- NeoForge 1.21.1
## Extra Info & Support
This is the first mod I've published, and my first time using NeoForge. I can not guarantee any new features, unless I hear something really good 😂

[Join my Discord server](https://ducky.wiki/travel/discord) if you have any issues installing/using the mod, I'll do my best to help. :)
